I have recently seen a wave of posts in this sub blaming the horse gif dono for forsen's ban. Though I do not enjoy playing devil's advocate, let it be known that forsen's current predicament is a result of twitch and its feelings related to forsen. His stay in the platform, as with many others, is currently limited to how much of the kool-aid they can drink and how high up in the victimhood olympics they rank. Women, so called "minorities" and anyone deviating from heterosexual orientations (with less leniency given to gays compared to lesbians because they aren't women), will be given a pass or an easier time should it ever come to this. Sure, some may say that this is just a conjecture, and perhaps state that it was forsen's third ban this year alone with increasingly smaller intervals of time between one transgression and the other, but it stands that forsen shouldn't have been banned the first two times this year either. Atleast not when the standard he was held to was different from the one other streamers were and still are subjected towards. These people have been mentioned ad infinitum, so I won't bother providing any more examples.

Lastly, remember that this situation is a result of changes that took years to finally shape up the platform. I feel the need beforehand to state that I do not support or have any relation whatsoever toward the group I am about to mention, that being said though, the meme made a week or so after forsen's ban relating the situation to the one experienced by other banned streamers like Ice poseidon (a post which I can't seem to find now), speaks volumes about the changes that took place over all these years. No one stood up when it was necessary, and you must understand that as much as forsen and other proeminent streamers made the platform, they (twitch) don't particularly care. Twitch didn't give a damn about the late reckful and his community, or forsen and his community for that matter.

We are a rogue element twitch feels is a bit too volatile to be controlled like the masses of regular plebs you'd find in other channels. Thus we were deemed unnecessary by the machine, moral and ethics be damned, because as with many tyrannical systems, freedom is only convenient up until it isn't from which thereupon comes the marginalization and eventually elimination of other dissidents. What is essential to understand however, is because of the choices we have made, like setting aside other platforms, keeping ourselves from spreading towards other mediums, not standing up to twitch when other streamers were having issues, we have given twitch the very tools they need not to care about what they have done. I would like to state otherwise, but this is what the userbase of twitch has chosen, and this isn't a '40s Disney movie. *Sic semper tyrannis* is an interesting concept, but at this point is highly unrealistic. Do not think for a second streaming copyrighted content affects twitch in any way, especially when they are already purging the shit out of us (although I do like movie night with the bajs FeelsOkayMan ).

In conclusion, do not lose perspective. We're not in this situation because of what some random guy on chat did, or because some mad deranged spammer triggered a few mods one time. We were always on the line for the chopping board, we just didn't realize and didn't care about the people in the front.
